page.overview:
Who is Agony?

Agony is a demon aspirant in the Candescent Creed, and one of the three sisters of Tyranny. As an NPC, Agony is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Agony is smaller than her sisters and has bright blue skin. She wears spectacles and her robes are monkish and hide her figure. She seems to be clumsy, frequently tripping and hurting herself. She appears to be the least assertive of the three sisters.

Tyranny met all three of her sisters at the Villa Aurora the day after Thjazi Fang's execution. Agony was the concerned about how Tyranny was doing, but when she learned she had made a friend of Thaisha Lloy, asked immediately if they would be able to "use her to our ends".

Agony was present in Riesingürtle when the Seekers arrived there. Her sister Enmity had encountered the group at a biergarten, posing as a ditzy missionary of the Candescent Creed, and learning from Thaisha Lloy her real name and that she had met both Tyranny and Wicander Halovar at the Lloy family estate. When Enmity joined her sisters at the Candescent Cathedral, she told them what she had learned from Thaisha. The sisters, who were searching for Wicander and Tyranny, suspected that Occtis Tachonis was actually Wick in disguise, and that Vaelus was Tyranny. They returned to the biergarten in search of the group, who had by that time left it.
